candidates.save-user: export function saveUser(record: User): void { repository.save(record); }
candidates.parse-user: export function parseUser(input: string): User { return JSON.parse(input); }
candidates.delete-user: export function deleteUser(id: string): void { repository.remove(id); }

candidates.read-exact: async function readExact(path: string): Promise<Uint8Array> { return fs.readFile(path); }
candidates.write-exact: async function writeExact(path: string, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<void> { await fs.writeFile(path, bytes); }
candidates.hash-content: function hashContent(bytes: Uint8Array): string { return sha256(bytes); }

candidates.remove-episode: async function removeEpisode(id: string): Promise<void> { await graph.removeEpisode(id); }
candidates.add-episode: async function addEpisode(text: string): Promise<void> { await graph.addEpisode(text); }
candidates.search-memory: async function searchMemory(query: string): Promise<Result[]> { return graph.search(query); }
